findings.finding: Patched boots are not depicted; footwear appears modern and unpatched.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael wears bulky lace-up boots with thick soles and no visible toe patches or thin, worn soles.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the footwear with battered 19th-century dark leather ankle boots showing visible toe patches and thin, scuffed soles; avoid modern thick/lugged soles or contemporary eyelets.

findings.finding: Outerwear reads as a long overcoat rather than the specified pea-coat.
findings.visible_evidence: The coat extends to mid-thigh/knee with a flaring hem, not a short, hip-length pea-coat.
findings.repair_prompt: Shorten and reshape the coat to a hip-length, double-breasted dark wool pea-coat with broad collar and nautical-style buttons.

findings.finding: Carpet-bag appears larger than the specified small compact travel bag.
findings.visible_evidence: The mottled fabric bag under Ishmael’s arm has the bulk of a medium doctor’s bag, protruding well beyond his torso.
findings.repair_prompt: Scale down the carpet-bag to a small, compact 19th-century soft-sided bag with worn leather trim; keep mottled fabric and scuffs.

findings.finding: Shot angle is side/three-quarter rather than a clear over-the-shoulder view from behind.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael is shown in right-profile with much of his face visible; the camera is not positioned behind his shoulder.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose to a long shot from behind Ishmael’s left shoulder, back to viewer, looking toward the empty snowy slip; maintain current environment and weather.

findings.finding: Carpet-bag depicted as a large duffel with a long shoulder strap, reading as a modern travel bag rather than a compact 19th-century carpet-bag.
findings.visible_evidence: Bulky bag under Ishmael’s arm with elongated strap and oversized volume relative to his torso.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the duffel with a small, soft-sided 19th-century carpet-bag of mottled fabric and leather trim; compact enough to tuck under the arm; no shoulder strap, no zipper or modern hardware; visibly scuffed and hand-carried.

findings.finding: Patched boot details are not clearly visible; toes and soles look worn but lack distinct patching.
findings.visible_evidence: Boots appear scuffed lace-ups without obvious rough toe patches or thin, battered soles.
findings.repair_prompt: Add clear rough toe patches and thinned, scuffed sole edges on the dark leather ankle boots to read as patched and well-worn.

findings.finding: Framing reads closer to a full-body/long shot rather than the specified medium three-quarter view, reducing emphasis on the coin-counting action.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael is shown head-to-toe with ample street visible around him; coins are small within the frame.
findings.repair_prompt: Tighten the composition to a medium three-quarter view centered on Ishmael’s torso and gloved palm with coins, keeping the bleak street as background context.

findings.finding: Additional human figures are visible in the distant street despite the contract listing only Ishmael as visible.
findings.visible_evidence: Two small silhouettes of pedestrians appear near the center-right distance along the street.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove background pedestrians or reduce them to unidentifiable atmospheric shapes so only Ishmael is recognizably present.

findings.finding: Carpet-bag reads as a modern patterned designer bag rather than a small 19th-century mottled carpet-bag.
findings.visible_evidence: The bag under Ishmael’s arm has a repeating monogram-like pattern, crisp structure, glossy leather trim, and metal studs/buckles that suggest a modern luxury handbag.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the bag with a small, soft-sided 19th-century carpet-bag: mottled fabric, scuffed, with simple worn leather trim and handle, no logos, no repeating pattern, no shiny hardware; keep it tucked under Ishmael’s arm.

findings.finding: Ishmael’s boots appear sturdy and unpatched, lacking the rough toe patches and thin worn soles specified.
findings.visible_evidence: Boots look thick-soled and intact with no visible patching at the toes.
findings.repair_prompt: Render dark leather ankle boots with evident wear: rough toe patches, scuffed uppers, and thinner, worn soles; avoid a new or heavy-sole look.

findings.finding: The image shows Ishmael passing the warm inn and heading toward the waterfront, but it is not clear he is turning into a darker side street.
findings.visible_evidence: Street extends straight toward the harbor; no narrow side lane is clearly depicted where Ishmael is stepping.
findings.repair_prompt: Adjust staging so Ishmael is angled into a narrower, darker side lane sloping downhill away from the bright inn, while the waterfront remains visible beyond.

findings.finding: Carpet-bag rendered as a modern-looking leather satchel instead of a small mottled-fabric 19th-century carpet-bag.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael clutches a smooth dark leather flap bag with strap/trim, no mottled tapestry-like fabric or leather-trimmed fabric body.
findings.repair_prompt: Replace the bag with a small, soft-sided 19th-century carpet-bag: mottled or tapestry-like fabric body with scuffed leather trim and handles; compact and hand-carried under the arm; avoid modern satchel silhouettes, long straps, or hardware.

findings.finding: Ash-box reads as an active brazier or coal container, emitting smoke, and lacks the ajar lid specified.
findings.visible_evidence: Low rectangular box at the threshold has dark cinders and visible wisps of smoke rising; no lid is present.
findings.repair_prompt: Depict a true ash-box: a low wooden or tin box half-filled with powdery gray stove ashes, lid present and ajar, fine ash dust scattered nearby; remove any smoke, glow, or embers so it does not read as a brazier or coal scuttle.

findings.finding: Ishmael’s boots appear worn but lack the clearly visible toe patches called for.
findings.visible_evidence: Boots show scuffs yet the toe areas look uniform without distinct patch pieces.
findings.repair_prompt: Make the ankle boots visibly battered with rough toe patches and thin, worn soles; avoid any new or uniform leather appearance.

findings.finding: Caption-zone failure: the reserved top-center area is occupied and visually busy.
findings.visible_evidence: A large wooden hanging sign and its chains extend through the top-center of the frame, with sleet and dark clouds behind it.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose to leave clear negative space in the top-center for the caption by shifting the sign leftward/upward or cropping lower; keep the top-center sky uncluttered and reduce precipitation contrast in that area.

findings.finding: Additional people are visible despite the storyboard listing only Ishmael.
findings.visible_evidence: Two small human figures are seen down the dock near lamplights at left background.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove or obscure distant figures so only Ishmael is discernible; keep the dockside empty or use non-human silhouettes like posts and rigging.

findings.finding: Patched boots, called out as a visible prop, are not visible in the frame.
findings.visible_evidence: The composition crops Ishmael below mid-thigh; no footwear is shown.
findings.repair_prompt: Adjust framing to include Ishmael’s lower legs and show dark, battered ankle boots with visible toe patches; avoid new or shiny footwear.
